prose.label: Reports that live elsewhere.
prose.text: The admin audit log export API is [[zia.audit-logs.report-api]] and the event log export is [[zia.audit-logs.event-log-report]]. The Shadow IT report is [[portfolio.saas-security-report]], the IoT report is [[zia.iot.discovery]], and Risk360's own scoring is [[risk360.overview]]. The programmatic analytics route is [[shared.analytics.graphql]]; no source maps its domains to these reports.

checks.do: Whether the administrator's role and scope, and the organization's subscriptions, allow the report to be seen before treating a missing report as removed.

role-and-scope-gate-reports.statement: An administrator's role and scope define which reports the administrator can view, and standard reports are available based on the organization's subscriptions; for example, mobile security reports can be viewed only with a Mobile Security subscription.

quotes: An administrator's role and scope define which reports the administrator can view.
Standard reports are available based on your organization's subscriptions. For example, you can view mobile security reports only if your organization has a Mobile Security subscription.

drill-down-to-logs.statement: Interactive reports support real-time interactive analysis, and a user can drill down from any report to the logs, where details such as the specific URLs users requested and the risk score of each URL are visible.

quotes: It supports real-time interactive analysis. You can seamlessly drill down from any report to the logs, where you can view details such as the specific URLs that users requested, risk score of each URL, and more.
